name: Reading Progress Bar
summary: Fixed top bar showing scroll progress through article.

states.name: default
states.description: Default reading-progress presentation before a target applies measured progress.

behavior.name: targetProgress
behavior.description: The target supplies measured progress and updates the bar; neutral calculation and accessibility semantics remain unresolved.

properties.name: indicator
properties.description: Target-owned progress indicator with any target-required state or semantics.

accessibility: Do not add live-region announcements for continuous scroll updates without an accepted behavior decision.
If a target exposes progressbar semantics, it must provide a useful accessible name and synchronized bounded values.
The visual indicator must not intercept pointer interaction with page content.

web.notes: Visual CSS is implemented; measurement and semantics are target-owned pending a source decision.
